summary: Frontend-only testing of LaundryMax Admin Command Center (/admin) on desktop (1400x900) and mobile (420x900). All 9 features specified in the review request passed end-to-end with zero failures.

issues: Auth badge text (Superadmin label + email) is hidden via `hidden sm:flex`; only the avatar 'T' is visible. Acceptable design choice but the spec implies the badge should be visible top-right; consider showing at least the 'Superadmin' label on small screens.

critical_code_review_comments: Recharts ResponsiveContainer logs harmless warnings ('width(-1) and height(-1) should be greater than 0') when the OverviewView is unmounted by view switching on mobile - cosmetic only.

AdminDashboard.jsx is ~770 lines; per code-review guidelines (>700 lines should be split), consider extracting OverviewView, PricingView, StaffReportView, B2BQuotaView into separate files under /components/admin/.

Pricing input uses formatted IDR string (e.g., '6.000') but stores numeric state - works correctly, but `add-pricing-row` and `pricing-delete-{id}` buttons are non-functional (no onClick); fine for mock but flag for next iteration.
handleLogout is mock-only (toast.info). Acceptable per mock spec.
seed_data_creation: None - all data is hardcoded mock in AdminDashboard.jsx
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 4 verified Segment 4 (Admin Command Center). Verified: admin-screen, admin-header, admin-auth-badge (Superadmin + theomahrizal@gmail.com), 4-pill HeaderNav (nav-cashier/production/courier/admin) with active yellow highlight, desktop admin-sidebar with all 4 items (sidebar-overview default active, sidebar-pricing/staff/b2b), Overview KPIs (Rp 4.820.000 / 182.5 Kg / Rp 460.000 / 23 Order), staff-performance-card with all 5 staff bars (dedi/rian/tono/asep/wawan), pricing-table-desktop with all 6 rows (kiloan/satuan/jas/sepatu/karpet/showcase) and 3-tier inputs (kiloan: tamel=6.000, laskita=7.500, member=5.400), pricing edit + save toast 'Perubahan harga tersimpan', staff-row-* for all 5, b2b-card-tamel/laskita/kostunpad/wins with laskita showing 'Hampir Habis' (95%), nav routing to /, /production, /courier all functional. Mobile 420x900: desktop sidebar hidden, admin-mobile-menu visible, opens admin-mobile-sidebar, backdrop click closes it.
rca of the issue: No issues found - all flows working as specified.
